concepts.gloss_en: "The way of the eagle in the heavens" (Proverbs 30:19) — scriptural phrase used as a mystical aspect (bechina) in Torah 29, linked to tikkun ha-brit, the radiance of the firmament, and whitening of sins

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are the identical Proverbs 30:19 phrase with identical vocalization (דֶּרֶךְ הַנֶּשֶׁר בַּשָּׁמַיִם), all in Torah 29, appearing in the same discourse about tikkun ha-brit and white garments. The two 'members' differ only by literal quotation marks, not by word or meaning. Clean single concept.
